verdict.rationale: Watchlist screening is a fair axis for an identity-verification product, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions sanctions, PEP, or adverse-media screening. The documented checks cover ID documents, selfie matching, SSN and id_number validation, and a merchant-managed document blocklist. That blocklist only blocks reuse of documents the merchant has flagged, so it is an adjacent control, not watchlist screening.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can screen verified users against sanctions, PEP, and adverse-media watchlists as part of the same verification — one vendor, one API, one review surface
